dict.string: LifeOptimizer uses the front camera to track facial features for personalized anomaly detection, and the camera to scan a Trusted Circle QR code when joining someone's circle. No video is recorded or transmitted.
LifeOptimizer connects to your own backend server on the same Wi-Fi network to send emergency incident details when a HIGH-confidence event is detected.
LifeOptimizer uses your location when a possible emergency is detected, so it can be included in the incident sent to your emergency contact.

If you've joined someone's Trusted Circle, LifeOptimizer shares your location in the background so they can be alerted if you're nearby during their emergency -- even if you're not actively using the app at that moment.
LifeOptimizer may use the microphone for an optional speech check during a medium-confidence alert.
LifeOptimizer uses motion sensors to detect unusual device movement that may corroborate a facial anomaly.
